lines: 仙魂斗战最新章节_第二十章 二轮惊喜第1页_仙魂斗战公孙慕容兰_热点小说网
> 第二十章 二轮惊喜（第1页）
原本九个人，只有八个人所选的人进入第二轮的，早早就有一个人退出了，那个人不由得非常之愤怒，他骂道：“tmd，真的害我输了！”
他此时愤然离开会场，这个是很正常的，毕竟赌注也不低了。
荼姚所选择之人，也进入第二轮，她看到焦伢所选择之人也进入，一下子就让她心情有点不爽了。
然而此时的荼姚原本想从抓住这个机会好好地羞辱一下焦伢的，结果却让焦伢一下子将了一军荼姚。
荼姚笑道：“焦伢，你所选之人真的不错啊！居然能够进入第二轮的比赛。”
可是焦伢此时早就已经将荼姚祖上十八代祖宗都已经问候一遍，他心里想：看来这一次我真的猜对了，看来这个人可能会有帮我将荼姚一军的实力。
焦伢不由得苦笑道：“他只不过是运气好而已！”
荼姚只不过想要尽快让焦伢出丑，站起来说：“接下来将会是第二轮凝神，各位能够进入第二轮绝对是丹药师之中的佼佼者，我希望你们可以做到百分之百尽全力去做，不要考虑那么多，只要你能够显露出自己的天赋，那么你就一定能够相当于的奖励。”
随着她的一声令下，众人纷纷开始第二轮凝神的比赛，然而冯斗比任何人都要清楚那就是现在就根本不需要继续掩饰下去。
他一下子就将四种药材加上刚刚炼制出来的药水，这下子就让众人不由得一惊的，就算是焦伢现在也算得上勉强地能够做到同时将五种草药在药鼎之中提炼乃至融合在一起。
可是现在的荼姚更加吃惊啦！她原本一点也看不起眼前的这个男子，当他显露出了自己的能力时，她觉得此人绝非一般人，在很大的程度上，根本就不是她能够阻碍得了的。
她马上暗中传音给族中的长老，她说：“无论如何都要除掉这个人！”
冯斗此时一点也顾忌其他的东西，他连忙将五种的药材凝聚成药丸，这样是对于灵力的损耗很大的。
他知道他的机会只有一次，根本就不是简单的事情，他只是用了十几分钟就已经完成了，然而此时其他人连最基本上的融合都还没有完成。
此次的冯斗显露出来的一切远远低超过了众人的所料，现在最高兴的人绝对是焦伢，他心里却是美滋滋的，因为他仿佛已经看到自己赢得最后赌注啦！
冯斗显露出来的一切足够证明了他有夺冠的实力，那就是代表着焦伢已经离赌注的胜利更加进一步啦！
冯斗此时离开比赛的台上，他现在根本就不需要再在等待，他已经完全进入第三轮，完全证明了自己的实力，他的目的已经达到，然而他要抓紧时间恢复体力和灵力，只有这样才可以做到第三轮时能够真正成功的。
他现在能够做到了事情，已经完全做好了。
因为他准备第三轮时，他炼制一枚高级极品丹药，所以他现在的实力来说，还没有能够百分百有这样的把握，所以他还是希望自己能够保持好最佳的状态来完成第三轮的比赛，他连忙吃下一颗恢复灵力的丹药。
他连忙炼化这一颗丹药，他马上感觉到自己体内的灵力基本上完全恢复过来了，他完全恢复过来时，他站起来，此时其他人也基本上完成第二轮的比赛。
原本就已经不到三百个人了，结果经过第三轮时，却只有七十三个人能够成功的，这一点反而让荼姚都有点吃惊的。
不过这一次八个进入第二轮被选中的人选，都已经进入第三轮，这样也让荼姚放心一点，如果她选中的人居然连第三轮都进不了，她就觉得丢脸丢大啦！
她心里想：也许他只是凝神方面强点，但是不代表他其他方面都很强的。

The latest chapter of the Fight between Immortal Souls_Chapter 20 The Second Round of Surprises Page 1_The Fight between Immortal Souls and Gongsun Murong Lan_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 20 Second round of surprises (Page 1)
Of the original nine people, only eight selected people to advance to the second round. One person withdrew early. That person couldn't help but become very angry. He cursed: "Tmd, I really lost!"
He left the venue angrily at this time, which was normal, after all, the stakes were high.
The person chosen by Tu Yao also entered the second round. She saw that the person chosen by Jiao Ya also entered, which suddenly made her feel a little unhappy.
However, at this time, Tu Yao originally wanted to seize this opportunity to humiliate Jiao Ya, but in the end, Jiao Ya defeated Tu Yao's entire army in one fell swoop.
Tu Yao smiled and said: "Jiao Ya, the person you chose is really good! He can actually enter the second round of the competition."
But Jiao Yao had already greeted all the eighteen generations of Tuyao's ancestors at this time. He thought to himself: It seems that I really guessed it right this time. It seems that this person may have the strength to help me conquer Tuyao's army.
Jiao Ya couldn't help but smile bitterly: "He's just lucky!"
Tu Yao just wanted to make Jiao Ya look embarrassed as soon as possible, and stood up and said: "The next will be the second round of concentration. Everyone who can enter the second round will definitely be the best among the alchemists. I hope you can do it with 100% effort and don't think so much. As long as you can show your talent, then you will definitely be rewarded accordingly."
Following her order, everyone started the second round of concentrated competition. However, Feng Dou knew better than anyone that there was no need to continue to cover up now.
He immediately added the four medicinal materials to the potion he had just refined. Everyone was shocked. Even Jiao You could barely refine and even fuse the five medicinal herbs in the medicine cauldron at the same time.
But now Tuyao is even more surprised! She originally looked down upon the man in front of her at all, but when he revealed his abilities, she felt that this man was no ordinary person. To a large extent, he was beyond her ability to hinder.
She immediately secretly sent a message to the elders of the clan, saying: "We must get rid of this person no matter what!"
Feng Dou didn't care about other things at this time. He quickly condensed five kinds of medicinal materials into pills, which would consume a lot of spiritual power.
He knew that he only had one chance, and it was not a simple matter at all. It only took him more than ten minutes to complete it, but at this time, others had not even completed the most basic integration.
What Feng Dou revealed this time was far lower than everyone expected. The happiest person now is definitely Jiao You, but he is very happy in his heart, because he seems to have seen that he has won the final bet!
Everything Feng Dou showed was enough to prove that he has the ability to win the championship, which means that Jiao Ya is one step closer to winning the bet!
Feng Dou left the competition stage at this time. He no longer needed to wait. He had fully entered the third round and completely proved his strength. His goal had been achieved. However, he had to seize the time to recover his physical and spiritual power. Only in this way could he truly succeed in the third round.
He is now able to do things and has done it completely.
Because when he was preparing for the third round, he refined a high-grade elixir, so in terms of his current strength, he was not 100% sure of it, so he still hoped that he could maintain the best condition to complete the third round. He quickly took a pill to restore spiritual power.
He quickly refined the elixir, and he immediately felt that the spiritual power in his body had basically fully recovered. When he fully recovered, he stood up. At this time, the others had basically completed the second round of the competition.
Originally there were less than 300 people, but after the third round, only 73 people were able to succeed, which surprised Tu Yao.
But this time, the eight candidates who entered the second round have all entered the third round. This also reassures Tuyao. If the person she selected cannot even enter the third round, she will feel embarrassed!
She thought to herself: Maybe he was just stronger in concentration, but that didn't mean he was strong in other aspects.
